$comment: Hand-written meaning of every data source Ask the Twin can reach. server/liveDc/dataDictionary.mjs merges it with the attribute lists from config/liveDc/*.json and the GeoJSON files; a test fails when a class or layer has no entry here.
overview: The I-595 Digital Twin covers the I-595 corridor in Broward County, Florida (I-75 in the west to US-1/Port Everglades in the east, ~11 miles). Records live in Bentley DataConnect: the customer's historical classes (read-only, 'Florida I595 ...') and SuperDNA's live classes ('SDNA Florida I595 Live ...') filled every few minutes from the FL511 feed. Corridor geometry and roadside assets also ship as GeoJSON layers.

workspaces.Traffic: FDOT traffic segments coloured by level of service, express lanes, ramps and live FL511 events.
workspaces.Safety: Crash hotspots, crash trends, live crashes and weather effects on the corridor.
workspaces.Maintenance: Historical and live tickets, tasks, work orders and inspections on the asset registry, with risk scoring.
workspaces.Live Ops: Live FL511 events from DataConnect with their camera photo, weather, conditions and the automatic response chain.

SDNA Florida I595 Live Events.purpose: One record per FL511 event near I-595 (incident, closure, construction, congestion, disabled vehicle). Written by the live sync; keyInSource is 'FL511-<fl511_item_id>'.
SDNA Florida I595 Live Events.notes: status turns 'cleared' when FL511 stops listing the event. Times are UTC ISO strings.

SDNA Florida I595 Live Tickets.purpose: The ticket opened automatically for a live event. keyInSource 'TIC-<event key>'.

SDNA Florida I595 Live Tasks.purpose: Field tasks under a live ticket (dispatch, mitigation, inspect and verify). keyInSource 'TSK-<event key>-NN'.
SDNA Florida I595 Live Tasks.links: Related Ticket ID = the ticket's Ticket ID.

SDNA Florida I595 Live Work Orders.purpose: The work order for a live event's response or repair. keyInSource 'WO-<event key>'.
SDNA Florida I595 Live Work Orders.links: Related Ticket ID and Related Task ID point back up the chain.

SDNA Florida I595 Live Inspections.purpose: The inspection recorded after a live event clears. keyInSource 'INSP-<event key>'.
SDNA Florida I595 Live Inspections.links: related_ticket_id / related_work_order_id point to the chain.

SDNA Florida I595 Live Asset Status.purpose: An asset marked damaged by a live event's inspection. keyInSource 'AST-<asset code>'.
SDNA Florida I595 Live Asset Status.links: asset_id = the asset registry code; source_inspection_id = the inspection.

Florida I595 Assets.purpose: The customer's asset registry (about 5,000 roadside assets: cameras, signs, lighting, detectors, drainage, structures ...).
Florida I595 Assets.notes: Historical, read-only. Asset IDs used by tickets and work orders are the asset code.

Florida I595 Incidents.purpose: Historical incidents with root cause, injuries, lane closure and damaged asset.

Florida I595 ITS Inspections.purpose: Historical inspections of ITS devices (cameras, signs, detectors ...).

Florida I595 Roadway Inspections.purpose: Historical roadway inspections (pavement, drainage, markings, guardrail, signs).

Florida I595 Safety Inspections.purpose: Historical roadside safety inspections (attenuators, guardrail, debris, clear zone).

Florida i595 Roadway Segments.purpose: The DataConnect roadway segments that records are assigned to.

chain: Every live event starts a chain: Live Event -> Live Ticket (source_event_id) -> Live Tasks (Related Ticket ID) -> Live Work Order (Related Ticket ID, Related Task ID) -> Live Inspection after the event clears (related_ticket_id, related_work_order_id) -> Live Asset Status for assets it damaged (source_inspection_id). All chain records also carry source_event_id. With the demo timing profile: task assigned 1 min after first seen, work order at 2 min, inspection 2 min after clearing, ticket closed 5 min after the inspection.

corridorLayers.i595_corridor_cameras.geojson: FDOT CCTV cameras along I-595 (camera_id, title, direction, divas_chan_id for live snapshots).
corridorLayers.i595_corridor_traffic_signals.geojson: Traffic signals at the interchanges (signal_id, cross_street, signal_type).
corridorLayers.i595_express_gantries.geojson: Express lane toll/DMS gantries (gantry_id, name, direction, milepost, dms_text).
corridorLayers.i595_fdot_traffic_segments.geojson: FDOT traffic segments with AADT (segment_id, direction, desc_from, desc_to, aadt, aadt_year).
corridorLayers.i595_ramps_connectors_classified.geojson: Ramps and connectors classified by function and connected road.
corridorLayers.main-highway.geojson: FDOT roadway record for the I-595 mainline.
corridorLayers.dnt-gantries.json: Toll gantry records used by the toll-plaza demo.

scoring: Asset risk (Maintenance) is a weighted score of age ratio, open tickets, recent work orders, manufacturer end-of-life, exposure and overdue inspection; red at >= 0.62, amber at >= 0.40 (src/scoringConfig.json).
limits: Ask the Twin reads only. It cannot create, change or close records. FL511 publishes only current events; history before the live sync started is only in the historical classes.
